{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=28|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[YouTube]] announces that it will turn off comments on videos featuring children under the age of 18 after reports that a [[Pedophilia|pedophile]] ring was operating in the comment sections of videos featuring minors, which subsequently led [[AT&T]], [[Nestle]] and [[Hasbro]] to suspend advertisements on the website. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-47408969 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit]], [[North Korea–United States relations]]
**The summit between [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] in [[Hanoi]] abruptly ends earlier than scheduled, with the [[White House]] saying no deal has been reached in regards to relations between the two countries and [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|North Korea's nuclear weapons policies]] and sanctions due to them. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/trump-begins-one-one-kim-jong-un-tempering-expectations-n977466 (NBC News)]
*[[2019 India–Pakistan standoff]], [[2019 Balakot airstrike]]
**[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] says that captured [[Indian Air Force]] pilot Abhinandan Varthaman will be released tomorrow as a gesture of peace. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/pakistan-to-release-indian-pilot-tomorrow-as-peace-pakistan-pm-imran-khan/articleshow/68201851.cms (Economic Times)] [https://in.reuters.com/article/india-kashmir-pilot-release/pakistani-pm-imran-khan-says-indian-pilot-to-be-released-friday-as-peace-gesture-idINKCN1QH1GH (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] rejected rival resolutions on [[Venezuela]] by the [[United States]] and [[Russia]] Thursday, with Russia and [[China]] vetoing the U.S. call for new elections and Moscow's proposal failing to win sufficient support. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/un-to-vote-on-rival-us-and-russian-resolutions-on-venezuela/2019/02/28/97181a58-3b80-11e9-b10b-f05a22e75865_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**Venezuelan opposition leader and interim president [[Juan Guaidó]] said Thursday he will return to his country by Monday, and that a dialogue with [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] won't be possible without discussing elections. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/28/americas/venezuela-juan-guaido-return/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Corruption in Israel]]
**The [[Attorney General of Israel]] [[Avichai Mandelblit]] says that after more than two years of investigations he has decided to indict [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] on charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust. [https://news.sky.com/story/israeli-pm-benjamin-netanyahu-faces-corruption-charges-11651195 (Sky News)]
